title: Access after changing a list entry
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list, let $q$ be an index with $q<\operatorname{length}(l)$, and let $a,d$ be elements of the same type. At any index $q'$, the entry at index $q'$ in the list obtained by replacing the entry at $q$ with $a$ is $a$ if $q'=q$, and otherwise is the entry at $q'$ in $l$; out-of-range access uses the default value $d$.
